comment: Conformance suites this core is held to. Pinned by commit so a run is reproducible; the weekly job proposes bumps.

generator.note: Where the corpus comes from, so it can be regenerated rather than only downloaded. The published files were checked against a run of this generator: 1593 of the 1604 come out byte for byte identical, and the eleven that do not are recorded in divergences.json.
generator.flagsNote: These are the settings that reproduce the published corpus. Turning the first on widens the read and write strobes to two T states, which is closer to the manual for data cycles and does not touch the opcode fetch, because the fetch is written with its first state hardcoded idle.
excludedFromPublication: opcode 0x100, the interrupt request pseudo entry
generator.excludedNote: The generator emits six files the published corpus does not carry, for those two pseudo entries and their two index prefixed forms. Every case in the interrupt one is a plain four state fetch, so it would not serve as an oracle for an acknowledge cycle even if it were published.
